svg.desc: The query creates descendant closure D, seeds nearest representatives from every nonempty attribute in D, and offers objects. Offers are marked once per query, filtered by scope before distance calculation, independently admitted into q1 and q2, then candidate queues are popped by distance and neighbors offered. When both candidate queues are empty, the keep sets are merged and deduplicated for top k.
svg.title: DQS query procedure with independent candidate and keep queues

path.aria-label: DQS：双准入通道，共享一次查询的候选展开
全 D 每个非空属性
本查询内后续重复调用返回
不算距离、不入队、不展开
keep₁ 容量 ef；准入时同时写入 cand₁ 与 keep₁
keep₁ 最远项决定准入阈值
独立尝试；keep₂ 容量 ef₂
准入时同时写入 cand₂ 与 keep₂
offer 邻居；陈旧项可展开，节点可重复展开
扫描局部边与跨属性边
再次调用 offer，访问代号阻止重复打分
否：两 cand 都空，结束
无每属性堆；不跨查询复用结果
ef / ef₂ 限制 keep 容量，不是 cand 的硬容量或距离调用上限；q2.keep 同样参与最终结果。
